requestContract.recordIdentity: exact Part 4A grain object; tenantId equals the snapshot tenant; every other value is a bounded non-empty source-owned opaque identifier

sourceVersion.rule: exactly one version or revision is present according to the trigger catalog and equals the designated Part 4A currentness pin

eventBinding.rule: eventKind selects exactly one Part 4A sourceField and sourceStateSelector; eventTime is the canonical UTC source-owned occurrence or effective time

currentness.rule: pins have exactly the Part 4A names; eventKind and eventTime pins equal the event binding; designated digest and version pins equal their separately named fields

provenance.actorRule: exact active tenant actor, session and membership must be resolved from PostgreSQL before first storage
provenance.eventRule: candidate provenance must equal a separately trusted server-resolved authenticated event value; no public or application-role storage entry point exists

lineage.rule: original is sequence one with null predecessor; correction is the next sequence for the same tenant, trigger, record identity and event kind and pins the exact predecessor ID and digest

requestContract.requestDigest: sha256 over the exact canonical request without requestDigest using the mission28.source-snapshot.request.v1 namespace

storedSnapshotContract.trustedObservedAt: PostgreSQL statement_timestamp rendered in canonical UTC and added by the store function; candidate input cannot supply or substitute it
storedSnapshotContract.snapshotDigest: sha256 over the exact stored snapshot without snapshotDigest using the mission28.source-snapshot.v1 namespace

storageContract.exactReplay: same tenant, snapshot ID, request digest and trusted provenance returns the one stored snapshot without a second row or a new observedAt
storageContract.conflictRule: same snapshot ID with any different canonical request or provenance fails closed
storageContract.correctionRule: corrections append and preserve every predecessor; update, delete and truncate are denied
storageContract.tombstoneRule: tombstone and replacement precedence remain Part 4D and are not accepted by this store

laterSliceBoundary.part4C: evaluation-time and immediately-pre-effect revalidation remains planned and unimplemented
laterSliceBoundary.part4D: duplicate coalescing, late/reordered facts, tombstones, reopen/reversal/replacement precedence and cross-request concurrency remain planned and unimplemented
laterSliceBoundary.part5Plus: rule evaluation, scheduling, execution, providers, recipients and effects remain planned and unimplemented
